name: Historic Centre of the Town of Olinda
description: Olinda is a hilltop colonial town on Brazil's northeastern coast, just north of Recife in Pernambuco. Settled by the Portuguese in the 1530s and rebuilt after Dutch looting, it grew rich on sugar cane. Today its steep cobbled lanes wind past colourful houses, gardens, convents and 20 Baroque churches, and its free street Carnaval fills them with music.
